name: Cera Sanitaryware Ltd
about: Cera Sanitaryware Ltd is engaged in the business of manufacturing, selling and trading of various kinds of building products. It also has non-conventional wind & solar power for captive use in the state of Gujarat.[1]
keyPoints:
Product Offerings
The company offers a full spectrum of products, including sanitaryware, faucetware, tiles, wellness products (bathtubs, shower panels & enclosures), kitchen sinks, and mirrors under three brands, Senator, CERA Luxe, and CERA, catering to evolving consumer aspirations. [1]

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 32.5%
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 9.63% over past five years.
